• Primary text: Maximum two sentences, each no longer than 14 words.
• Headlines: Maximum 12 words.
• Present the output in a table format with the primary text on the left and the corresponding headlines on the right.

• Avoid using \\[informal/formal\\] language.
• Use a \\[positive/aspirational/cynical/sarcastic\\] tone.
• Do not use these words: \\[list any off-brand words\\].
